name: Bill
source:
A lizard who is in good competition to the Cheshire Cat in how laid-back he is.

Quiet and polite, yet a sadistic aura hangs off him in sheets. Almost always has a slight smile on his face, but unlike the Cheshire Cat, he can do other expressions as well. If he wants to, that is.

[Edited from in-game profile]
